choices.label: Share the recording with Morris
choices.impact: Morris identifies a voice in the recording. Morris can watch for danger, but he needs you to share each clue before he can act.
choices.response: Morris identifies a voice in the recording. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Let Amara decode the message
choices.impact: Amara identifies a factory extension in the recording. Amara stays involved, but the signal could be a decoy. David will still need physical evidence.
choices.response: Amara identifies a factory extension in the recording. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: Amara

choices.label: Question the technician myself
choices.impact: David earns the technician's trust and learns about a service entrance. You can investigate quietly, but no one will be close enough to help immediately if Victor is waiting.
choices.response: David earns the technician's trust and learns about a service entrance. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: David

dialogues.speaker: Detective Morris
dialogues.text: The workshop owner found a receiver hidden under his bench. Its last signal came from an industrial property outside town.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Victor used the workshop to hide his trail. That receiver is still warm.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then Ethan may be close. David, listen: someone just tried to call from the receiver.

police.speaker: David
police.text: Morris recognizes the recorded voice as a former factory guard. He sends us to the technician who repaired its radio.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: Amara decodes a factory extension in the message. The technician can tell us where it connects.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: The technician agrees to speak to me privately. Victor asked him to repair a service-door radio.
